Class SelectedActionButtonChangeListener

java.lang.Object
jmt.framework.gui.listeners.SelectedActionButtonChangeListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeListener, EventListener, ChangeListener
public class SelectedActionButtonChangeListener extends Object implements PropertyChangeListener, ChangeListener

Name: SelectedActionChangeListener

Description: A property change listener that will reflect the status of an action on a button and vice versa. This is used to implement selected state in actions.
